title: Singular-variation criterion for subcritical perturbed Brownian reflection
limitations: Automatic well-posedness for locally absolutely continuous boundaries is proved only for nu < 1/2.
For singular increasing boundaries, the exact criterion depends on the contact set of the unique Skorokhod candidate rather than only on deterministic regularity data of the boundary.
Absolute continuity of the boundary is sufficient and is not claimed to be necessary.
The full critical one-half Holder class is not classified.
